verdict.rationale: No evidence of any documented reference architecture, scaling guide, or HA/cluster deployment pattern for tens of thousands of users; only generic single-server/replication deployment mentions (gitea-docs-13) and community reports that Gitea 'starts hitting various issues' once you scale beyond small teams (gitea-comm-13, gitea-comm-15). missing for 10: published reference architecture docs, benchmarks/case studies at tens-of-thousands-user scale, HA/clustering guidance.
